title: Quarterly Alignment: Hosted API & Model Catalog Initiative — Dependency Map and Risk Mitigation Plan
creator: Aisha Gomez
description:
Objective: Produce a concise dependency map and mitigation plan that aligns the Hosted API quarterly roadmap with the model catalog onboarding schedule. The output will be used by Product, Eng, and Design to prioritize work, set realistic rollouts, and identify required infra changes or gating criteria.

Scope: Hosted API product-level features impacting model catalog (model gating, version pinning, canary/rollout controls, catalog metadata APIs) and the infra/serving work required to support them (kernel scheduling changes, KV cache behavior, dedicated capacity reservations, quantization compatibility). Excludes long-term research on new model architectures.

Deliverables:
- Visual dependency map (teams, milestones, blockers) for the quarter.
- Top 8 risks with concrete mitigations and owners.
- A prioritized action list (30/60/90 day) for PM/Eng/Design syncs.
- Acceptance criteria to gate model catalog onboarding phases (staging, canary, GA).

Why this ticket: In prior quarters we surfaced misaligned expectations between model onboarding timelines and infra availability (notably during the runtime-1.18 rollout). This ticket formalizes cross-team dependencies early in planning to reduce last-minute de-scopes and customer-impacting regressions.
acceptance_criteria: A dependency map (diagram + one-page summary) stored in Confluence linked below
Each top-8 risk has a named owner and at least one concrete mitigation with ETA
Action list contains owners and 30/60/90 day checkpoints that map to existing cycles
Agreeable gating criteria documented for Staging→Canary→GA model onboarding and signed off by Eng and Security
Milestone alignment confirmed in the cross-team planning meeting (date recorded in comments)
